newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Victor Ek sells ops to Danzas.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Victor Ek sells ops to Danzas.

text.p: Finnish privately-owned forwarding company Oy Victor Ek Ab said in a statement on Monday it would sell some of its business operations to Swiss freight forwarder Danzas AG.

The operations to be sold -- European transports, air cargo and international stevedoring -- account for about half of Victor Ek's turnover, which was around 180 million markka in 1996, Victor Ek Managing Director Goran Cedercreutz said by telephone. He declined to give the price of the deal.
The operations will be sold to a new company to be set up in Finland. Danzas will own 100 percent of the new company.
"The know-how and client relationships built up by Victor Ek over the years will be best secured by joining these operations with an international group, Danzas," Victor Ek said in the statement.
Victor Ek will focus on its core businesses, removals and sea transports, it said.
